title: Gethsemane

bsb: At that time Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them,
kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples,

bsb: Sit here while I go over there and pray.
kjv: Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

bsb: My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.
kjv: My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

bsb: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed,
kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying,

bsb: My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.
kjv: O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

bsb: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping.
kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep,

bsb: Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?
Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
kjv: What, could ye not watch with me one hour? Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

bsb: Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners. Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!
kjv: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners. Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

puzzles.prompt: Jesus went away to pray, again and again.
puzzles.question: How many times did Jesus go away to pray?

puzzles.hint: Jesus told them to stay awake and talk to God.

bsb: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.
kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation:

scenes.title: The Arrest
scenes.note: John 18:10 tells us it was Peter who used the sword, and that the servant's name was Malchus. Luke 22:51 tells us Jesus healed his ear.

bsb: Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.
kjv: Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

bsb: Put your sword back in its sheath!
Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?
kjv: Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

bsb: And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
kjv: And he touched his ear, and healed him.

bsb: Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.
kjv: Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

puzzle.prompt: What did Jesus do for the servant whose ear was cut off?

choices.text: He touched his ear and healed him

puzzle.hint: Even while He was being arrested, Jesus was kind.

bsb: Yet not as I will, but as You will.
kjv: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

reflect: Jesus was very sad and troubled, but He prayed, “Not as I will, but as You will,” and obeyed His Father.
discuss: Jesus was deeply sad in the garden. What did He do with His sadness?
The disciples fell asleep. Why is it sometimes hard to pray?
Even while He was arrested, Jesus healed the servant's ear. What does that show about Him?
prayer: Father, when we are sad or afraid, help us pray like Jesus did: not our will, but Yours be done. Amen.
